name: Sacred Old Tom Gin
production: Vacuum distillation (Difford's says of the orange peel; Master of Malt says of the liquorice root)
High-strength take on the 18th-century Old Tom, slightly sweeter style
history: 2019 | Best Old Tom Gin, World Gin Awards
notes: Sources disagree on which botanical is vacuum-distilled [cần kiểm tra]. 290 kcal/100 ml per Difford's.
